name: @playform/ets-plugin-dsh-workspace-semantics
description: The workspace-semantics service: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that owns the semantic model - the symbols + the references + the dependencies + the index (the family map's SEMANTICS role). It registers the workspaceSemantics service (ctx.workspaceSemantics) and is the second step of the invisible flow, right after the observe stamps: on every fs/observed event heard through the factory's Wire registration the stale model for the path is dropped and the index revision advances; a resolve() call builds the model lazily through the file type's adapter. The rename semantics are per-adapter (the rename means different things per format - the .ts symbol vs the .docx displayed text); an extension with no adapter gets the refusal-to-guess answer, never a guessed plan. The plugin ships DISABLED - the IDLE-forever posture. Plan: Documentation/Plans/Workspace-Family/SEMANTICS.md.
